dialogues.speaker: Sieciech
dialogues.text: Hello, Final Trial Guardian. Would you like to begin with the contestants now?

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: Alright. Please follow me to the arena then.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: You remember me? You've got a good memory.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: You saw me at the Lightkeepers' office, when you were on an investigation. I was called there by Lady Nefer to handle some paperwork.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: Thank you for all that you did for Sergeant Major Sousi.

choices.text: Huh. I didn't realize that the Lightkeepers were involved in this competition too.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: I suppose I can be honest with you since you work with Lady Nefer.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: This competition had nothing to do with the Lightkeepers originally, and we generally don't get involved in events like this either.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: However, to ensure our combat readiness, we have to learn about and assess the combat capabilities of various parties from time to time.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: And personally, the more I know, the better too.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: That's why I went along with Sarin's suggestion and took on the role of the host in his place.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: And I've definitely seen several really capable individuals in action so far. Unfortunately, most of them are no longer here after being eliminated by our three finalists.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: Actually, I'm also really curious to see what happens when Mr. Kaedehara really goes all out.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: Our three finalists are pretty much aces in their own right. If you ask me, the only people in Nod-Krai who are better fighters than they are would be Lady Nefer, Flins, Officer Illuga, and Jahoda.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: But I can't help feeling that under Mr. Kaedehara's polite and easygoing presence lies a certain depth that's quietly profound.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: Even during matches that have left me slack-jawed, he seems long accustomed to such scenes, delivering calm and objective commentary throughout.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: Of course, that humble yet unflappable demeanor is something every warrior... or, more elegantly put, every "martial artist" can learn from.

choices.text: We have faced life-and-death situations together.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: No wonder. The way you two interact, it's like comrades who have fought bloody battles side by side.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: To be someone to stand beside you against powerful foes... That certainly commands respect.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: To make up for that, I shall personally throw a dinner in Mr. Kaedehara's honor after the competition.

choices.text: He stopped the blade of a God.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: ...Is that some kind of metaphor? If it is, it's certainly a striking one.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: With such high praise coming from you, it seems I haven't been giving him the respect he deserves...

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: Sure. That'd give our finalists some time to prepare in the meantime.
